summary: C++ walkthrough on the Third Person template that adds a replicated CurrentHealth with a RepNotify, a TakeDamage override, a replicated projectile actor (Sphere + ProjectileMovementComponent + ApplyPointDamage + explosion on Destroyed) and a Server RPC to fire it, then tests with Play As Listen Server. The projectile/damage code also works as a single-player example.
gotchas: Must call Super::GetLifetimeReplicatedProps or inherited replicated properties stop replicating
Server does not receive RepNotifies; call the update function manually on the server
Reliable RPC queue can overflow and disconnect the player if bound directly to input; rate-limit with a timer
Server RPC implementation needs the _Implementation suffix; uses legacy BindAction input, not Enhanced Input

summary: Conceptual overview of UE client-server networking: network modes (ENetMode), listen vs dedicated servers, what actor replication covers (spawn/destroy, movement, properties, components, subobjects, RPCs), the three replication systems (generic, Replication Graph, Iris) and general networking tips.
gotchas: Skeletal/static mesh components, materials, Anim Blueprints, particles, sounds and physics objects do not replicate
Standalone mode runs server and client logic, so multiplayer-written gameplay works single-player unchanged

summary: How to enable Oodle Network packet compression: add OodleNetworkHandlerComponent to the net driver packet handler config, capture packets with -OodleCapturing, train dictionaries with the OodleNetworkTrainerCommandlet, point ServerDictionary/ClientDictionary at the .udic files, and verify they are packaged.
gotchas: Needs 50 MB or more of representative packet captures for training
Dictionaries must be retrained and shipped when gameplay changes appreciably between patches
Packet handlers exist only on active connections, so debugging needs a connected client

summary: Short list of ways to cut actor replication cost, in priority order: disable replication, lower NetUpdateFrequency, dormancy, relevancy, NetClientTicksPerSecond; plus avoiding unneeded replicated properties, using quantized types and avoiding FName RPC parameters.
gotchas: FName RPC parameters are generally not compressed and send the string each call

summary: C++ reference for replicating actor properties: Replicated, ReplicatedUsing (RepNotify, optionally receiving the previous value), NotReplicated, replication conditions (COND_*), RepNotify conditions, custom conditions via DOREPLIFETIME_ACTIVE_OVERRIDE in PreReplication, replicated object references and stably named objects, plus a macro reference table.
gotchas: A property registered for replication cannot be unregistered
Custom conditions are per actor, not per connection, and cost more than built-in conditions
In Blueprint a Set node calls the RepNotify automatically; by-reference modifications do not
_FAST macro variants do not work with arrays

summary: How to make actor components replicate as part of their replicating owner, for constructor-created components (SetIsReplicatedByDefault), runtime components (SetIsReplicated), and Blueprint components (Replicates checkbox / Set Is Replicated node), plus component subobjects and bandwidth overhead.
gotchas: Both the owning actor and the component must be set to replicate
Component RPCs cost more than actor RPCs; consider routing them through the actor
A subobject's condition is only checked after its owning component replicates to that connection

summary: How to replicate plain UObjects as subobjects of an actor or component, using either the registered subobjects list (AddReplicatedSubObject, required for Iris) or the legacy ReplicateSubobjects override; covers default vs dynamic subobjects, Iris RegisterReplicationFragments, COND_NetGroup groups, routing RPCs, and debug console variables.
gotchas: Iris supports only the registered subobjects list; an ensure fires if it is disabled while Iris is on
Call RemoveReplicatedSubObject before modifying or deleting a subobject or a crash follows garbage collection
Registered list does not support UActorChannel::KeyNeedsToReplicate; use push model
Subobject RPCs need GetFunctionCallspace and CallRemoteFunction overrides

summary: Explains the Replication Graph plugin, which uses persistent Replication Graph Nodes to build per-connection replication lists for games with many players and actors, and how to enable a custom Replication Driver via DefaultEngine.ini or CreateReplicationDriverDelegate.
gotchas: Disabled on console builds because it does not work in splitscreen games

summary: Tutorial using Lyra to build Development Server and Development Client targets in Visual Studio, cook WindowsServer/WindowsClient content from the Platforms menu, then run the server exe and connect clients to 127.0.0.1:7777.
gotchas: Requires a source build of Unreal Engine and a C++ project
Running the server before cooking fails with missing shaders
Dedicated server listens on port 7777 by default

summary: Debugging guide for multiplayer: launching a separate server from PIE, connecting with open 127.0.0.1:<PORT>, effects of Run Under One Process on tick rate, debugger watch variables to identify instances, actor network roles, and pointers to Networking Insights, Network Profiler, Gauntlet and functional tests.
gotchas: PIE net modes connect by IP without the Session Interface, so session-based features like voice chat are unavailable
Server/client travel must be tested in Standalone, not PIE
Functional tests spanning client and server instances are not supported

summary: Shows the Play-button multiplayer options in the editor: number of players, separate PIE windows, multiplayer viewport size, Run Dedicated Server, gamepad routing, single vs multiple process, and listen vs dedicated server.
keys: Create Audio Device for Every Player
gotchas: Use Single Process loads faster but may have more issues

summary: Explains seamless vs non-seamless map travel in multiplayer, when to use UEngine::Browse, UWorld::ServerTravel and APlayerController::ClientTravel, how to enable seamless travel with a transition map, and which actors persist.
gotchas: First map load, first client connection and starting a new game always use non-seamless travel
If TransitionMap is empty an empty map is created for it

summary: How to simulate latency, packet loss, reordering and duplication via Editor Preferences (Enable Network Emulation with Average/Bad profiles), command line, NetEmulation console commands or [PacketSimulationSettings] in config, with a settings reference.
gotchas: PktLag cannot be used with PktOrder
PktLagVariance requires PktLag

summary: Covers Online Beacons for lightweight client-server contact without a full game connection (ping, reservations, session queries): class structure (AOnlineBeaconClient/Host/HostObject), the engine test beacons, BeaconNetDriver config, and a full ping-beacon C++/Blueprint sample with debugging tips.
gotchas: Beacon host ListenPort must match the port passed to InitClient
Testing needs a separate server process and Run Under One Process disabled

summary: How to enable the Steam Sockets plugin (Steamworks SDK 1.46+ net protocol with relay, encryption and NAT traversal) by switching NetDriverDefinitions to SteamSocketsNetDriver, plus the bUseSteamNetworking and bAllowP2PPacketRelay settings.
gotchas: Steam Sockets builds only connect to other Steam Sockets builds
Windows, Mac and Linux only; stripped for other platforms
Non-Steam PC stores still package the Steam net driver and need separate config
Broken in 4.27.0, fixed in 4.27.2

summary: How to record network profiling data (networkprofiler=true or netprofile console command) to a .nprof file and inspect per-actor, property and RPC bandwidth in the standalone NetworkProfiler.exe tool.
gotchas: Requires an engine built with STATS enabled (debug or editor build)
Client recordings only show detail for RPCs sent from that client
Legacy tool; Networking Insights is more detailed

summary: Overview of the Replay system, which records replicated data through DemoNetDriver for later playback (works in single-player and PIE too), with the C++ functions and console commands to record, stop, play, scrub, pause and change speed, and replay version compatibility hooks.
gotchas: Only replicated data is recorded, so the project must be set up to replicate
Structs with custom NetSerialize must handle format changes manually for backward compatibility

summary: Hub page for Network Multiplayer Basics; the extracted page has no body content.
Hub page for publishing multiplayer games and deploying servers; the extracted page has no body content.

How to use the Iris filtering system to control which connections an object replicates to: owner filters, connection allow/disallow filters, group filters, and custom dynamic filters (UNetObjectFilter) registered in config.
gotchas: Experimental
Dynamic filters run after connection/group filters and cannot re-enable filtered objects
Dynamic filters add significant CPU overhead; use as a last resort
An object can have only one dynamic filter at a time

summary: How Iris ranks objects for replication with accumulating priorities: setting static priorities, assigning built-in dynamic prioritizers (sphere, sphere with owner boost, object count limiter) with their config defaults, and registering a custom UNetObjectPrioritizer.
gotchas: Experimental
Priority below 1.0 means the object is not considered for replication that frame

summary: Hub page for testing, debugging and optimizing networked projects; briefly lists the challenges (multiple instances, unreliable connections, client vs server behaviour) and links to the guides.
Hub page for network programming how-to guides and examples; the extracted page has no body content.

Reference for UBT .Target.cs files: target types (Game, Client, Server, Editor, Program), the TargetRules class structure, and the full list of read-only and read/write TargetRules properties (plugins, unity/PCH, debug info, shipping logging/console, optimization, linking, warnings).
gotchas: Class name must match the file name plus 'Target' (MyProject.target.cs defines MyProjectTarget)
MinCpuArchX64/bMinCpuArchAPX raise min spec and the exe crashes on CPUs without support
bUseIncrementalLinking is off by default because it can cause PDB-related errors
Several merge/strip module options are experimental

summary: Online Subsystem Friends Interface: reading and caching friends lists, sending/accepting/rejecting invites, deleting friends or lists, querying recently met players, and managing the block list, all via async delegates.
gotchas: FOnSendInviteComplete only means the invite was sent, not received or answered
Friends lists change at any time; re-call ReadFriendsList to keep the cache current

summary: Online Subsystem Identity Interface: logging local users in and out of an online service, checking login status, converting between FUniqueNetId and platform IDs, reading user account data and display names, and checking user privileges.
gotchas: Each local user logs in separately
Some platforms do not use FOnlineAccountCredentials and require the built-in login UI
GetSponsorUniquePlayerId is only implemented for Xbox Live
